import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a playable browser football game inspired by EA SPORTS FC Mobile in the empty PlayGround repo, with match gameplay, squad building, player packs, and progression.

## Requirements
- User request (Vietnamese): "Tạo một game giống fc mobile".
- Deliver a polished, self-contained web game; no real-world licensing implied.
- Vietnamese UI, mobile-first, touch controls plus keyboard fallback.
- No explicit additional constraints stated by user.

## Decisions
- Created original brand **FC NOVA**, fictional players/teams, with a disclaimer not affiliated with EA SPORTS FC Mobile.
- Stack: static HTML/CSS/vanilla JS, custom canvas pseudo-3D renderer, no external runtime libraries.
- Local Barlow/Barlow Condensed fonts downloaded into `assets/fonts/` (offline-friendly).
- Implemented 11v11 match (3 real minutes mapped to 90 game minutes), AI teammates/opponents, 4 difficulties.
- Added Quick Match, 3-round Cup Nova tournament, squad management (3 formations), store packs with reveal animation, profile/achievements, daily coins, localStorage saves.
- Sound synthesized via WebAudio (no audio assets).
- Match camera is perspective pseudo-3D behind the ball; stylized billboard players with generated avatars on cards.

## Work State
### Completed
- Core files created: `index.html`, `css/style.css`, `js/data.js`, `js/audio.js`, `js/store.js`, `js/ui.js`, `js/engine.js`, `js/main.js`.
- 20-player starting collection; auto-pick squad; 4-3-3/4-2-3-1/3-5-2 formations.
- Home, squad, store, profile screens render successfully; setup modal verified.
- Match starts and renders: pitch, goals, crowd, players, ball, HUD, joystick/action buttons.
- Fonts fixed after initial 404s (`assets/fonts/fonts.css` now uses `url('./...')`).
- Local static server running on port 3002; Playwright Chromium 1243 installed.

### Active
- Debugging match clock: after starting a match, `#match-clock` remained `00:00` after ~3 seconds (screenshot `screenshots/match1.png`), so gameplay simulation may not be advancing or screenshot timing/engine state needs investigation.
- Visual QA of match rendering and HUD (e.g. active player nameplate overlaps a nearby red player in screenshot; controls/HUD layout tuning needed).
- Mobile/responsive testing not yet done (viewport currently ~1050x800).

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect engine loop/state via Playwright console: confirm `FCN.app` engine internals (`elapsed`, `state`, `freeze`, `paused`, `raf`) and why clock stays 00:00; check for runtime exceptions.
2. Test actual gameplay interactions (joystick, pass, shoot, tackle, sprint), goal scoring, halftime/fulltime, pause/result overlays, rewards.
3. Test pack opening, squad slot picker, player detail, cup flow, daily reward, reset.
4. Resize to mobile viewport (e.g. 390x844) and fix responsive layout/overlaps, especially squad pitch and fixed bottom nav hiding content.
5. Tune match visuals/camera/player scale and HUD (nameplate collision, touch control positions, commentary).
6. Re-run screenshots, verify no console errors, then clean up and commit changes.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/engine.js`: match simulation, AI, ball physics, canvas renderer, controls, camera, HUD; main debugging target.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/main.js`: app bootstrap, match session, result/cup reward logic, replay/home/next handlers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/ui.js`: screen rendering, modals, setup/cup, pack reveal, squad interactions, match overlays.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/store.js`: save state, squad auto-pick, packs, achievements, daily reward.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/data.js`: players, formations, teams, opponents, difficulties, packs, news.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/audio.js`: synthesized sound effects/crowd.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: app shell, all screens, match DOM/HUD, SVG icon sprite.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/css/style.css`: full responsive styling plus detail/cup modal styles.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/`: home/squad/store/profile/setup/match screenshots for visual QA.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/assets/fonts/fonts.css`: local font-face declarations (paths fixed).

## Important Context
- Static server: `nohup python3 -m http.server 3002 --directory /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround` (running); URL `http://localhost:3002`.
- Playwright CLI commands: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002`, `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/x.png [--full-page]`, `playwright-cli eval "() => ..."`.
- Use specific selectors for nav, e.g. `.nav-item[data-nav=squad]`, because `[data-nav=...]` matches multiple buttons and strict-mode click fails.
- No git commits made; several files are untracked/changed. Repo originally contained only README/Agents/runtime scripts.
- In `openSetup`, cup round mapping was fixed to `round = clampInt((cup.round || 1) - 1, 0, 2)` and `clampInt` added to `ui.js`.
- Potential engine bug candidates: `frame(dt)` clock updates depend on `state === "play"` and `freeze`; `this.paused` may be set via visibility change; check `updatePlay`/`updateHUD` and whether `elapsed` advances.
- Known code quirks to verify: `drawParticles` calls `ctx.setTransform` per particle; `tryPickup` computes speed before zeroing now (patched); goal-reset kickoff mapping patched; `updateRestartMovement` `pitcherZ` typo patched.
- Match HUD is DOM overlay: scoreboard IDs `sb-home-score`, `sb-away-score`, clock `match-clock`, banner `match-banner`, commentary `commentary`, overlay `match-overlay`.
- Match controls: joystick `#stick-zone`/`#stick-knob`; buttons `#btn-pass`, `#btn-shoot`, `#btn-sprint`, `#btn-tackle`; keyboard WASD/arrows, J pass, K shot (hold), Shift sprint, L tackle, Esc pause.

playwright-cli - run playwright mcp commands from terminal

Usage: playwright-cli <command> [args] [options]
Usage: playwright-cli -s=<session> <command> [args] [options]

Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser
  attach [name]               attach to a running playwright browser
  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
  type <text>                 type text into editable element
  click <target> [button]     perform click on a web page
  dblclick <target> [button]  perform double click on a web page
  fill <target> <text>        fill text into editable element
  drag <startTarget> <endTarget> perform drag and drop between two elements
  drop <target>               drop files or data onto an element
  hover <target>              hover over element on page
  select <target> <val>       select an option in a dropdown
  upload <files...>           upload one or multiple files
  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window
  delete-data                 delete session data

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page
  reload                      reload the current page

Keyboard:
  press <key>                 press a key on the keyboard, `a`, `arrowleft`
  keydown <key>               press a key down on the keyboard
  keyup <key>                 press a key up on the keyboard

Mouse:
  mousemove <x> <y>           move mouse to a given position

## FC NOVA — Mobile Football

A playable browser football game inspired by the squad-building and match flow of mobile football titles. It is an original project with fictional clubs, players, kits, and branding.

- 11v11 matches with a pseudo-3D canvas pitch, AI teammates and opponents, four difficulty levels, halves, restarts, and a full-time report.
- Quick Match and the three-round Nova Cup knockout tournament.
- Squad management with three formations, automatic line-ups, player details, and position pickers.
- Card packs with an animated reveal, daily coin rewards, achievements, and a persistent local save.
- Vietnamese UI, mobile touch controls, and keyboard support.

### Run locally

Serve the folder with any static file server, then open `index.html`:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 8080
```

No build step or runtime dependency is required. The Barlow fonts are bundled locally.

### Controls

- Move: on-screen joystick / `WASD` or arrow keys
- Pass or switch player: `CHUYỀN` / `J`
- Shoot (hold to charge): `SÚT` / `K`
- Sprint: `TỐC ĐỘ` / `Shift`
- Tackle: `CƯỚP` / `L`
- Pause: pause button / `Esc`

FC NOVA is not affiliated with EA SPORTS or FC Mobile.
